name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the execution spree in Iran and confirmation of the death sentences of activists Behrouz Ehsani and Mehdi Hassani
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on Iran. It condemns the rise in executions, including the death sentences against activists Behrouz Ehsani and Mehdi Hassani. It calls on Iran to stop executions and free political prisoners and European Union nationals held there. It also asks European Union countries to make better relations with Iran depend on these releases and on ending the death penalty.

- **What changes:** Nothing legally. Parliament only states its opinion and makes requests.
- **Who it affects:** Iran's government, prisoners named in the text, and European Union nationals held in Iran.
- **What happens next:** Parliament sends the text to European Union institutions and Iranian authorities. They decide whether to act.
